summary: A Yes vote replaces Berkeley's existing $0.01-per-fluid-ounce tax on the distribution of sugar-sweetened beverages with a $0.02-per-fluid-ounce special tax, estimated to raise about $2.2 million annually, to fund public health, nutrition, and drinking-water programs.

tax.text: Supports Measure AA, which would increase the sugary-drink distributor tax to fund community health, school nutrition, and water-access programs.
tax.quote: By increasing the tax levied on distributors of sugary drinks to 2 cents per ounce, Measure AA lets us stay ahead of inflation and continue to fund community-based health solutions
